Home.whoTitle: Born in Kathmandu, at home on the trail
Home.whoText1: Royal Himalaya Experiences is a small team of guides, drivers and trip planners. We design every itinerary ourselves, walk the routes we sell, and keep groups small so the mountains stay the main event.
Home.whoText2: Whether it is your first teahouse trek or a crossing of a 5,000-metre pass, we handle the permits, flights and logistics so you can focus on the view.
Home.boudhanathAlt: Prayer flags above the Boudhanath stupa
Home.interestsText: Start with what you love doing and we'll match you with the right trail, jungle or city.
Home.durationTitle: How much time do you have?
Home.durationText: From a morning hike above Kathmandu to a three-week circuit of the Annapurnas.
Home.departuresText: Travelling solo or as a couple? Join one of our scheduled small-group departures — or pick any date for a private trip.
Home.closingText: Tell us your dates and dream trip — we'll plan the rest.

About.metaDescription: Who we are and how we travel responsibly in the Himalaya.
About.title: Local people, local knowledge
About.whoTitle: A Kathmandu team that walks every trail
About.whoText1: Royal Himalaya Experiences started with a simple idea: the best way to see the Himalaya is with someone who grew up there. Our guides come from Solukhumbu, Gorkha, Mustang and the Kathmandu Valley, and each one leads trips in the region they know best.
About.whoText2: We keep the company small on purpose. Every itinerary is designed by our own team, every route is walked before we sell it, and when you message us you talk to the people who will plan your trip.
About.responsibleText: Tourism keeps many mountain villages alive. We want every trip to leave the places we visit a little better off.

porters.title: Porters come first
porters.text: Fair wages paid on time, a 20 kg load limit, proper boots and warm gear, and insurance for every porter we hire.

local.title: Money stays local
local.text: We use family-run teahouses and lodges, local drivers and regional guides so your spending supports mountain communities.

trace.title: Leave no trace
trace.text: Refillable bottles and purification on every trek, and we carry our rubbish back out of the national parks.

culture.title: Respect for culture
culture.text: Our guides brief every group on local customs, dress and photography etiquette at temples and monasteries.
